title: How Border Politics Landed in Martha’s Vineyard

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史工艺品的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: When nearly 50 Venezuelan migrants showed up without warning on the wealthy island of Martha's Vineyard,
sentences.zh: 当近50名委内瑞拉移民毫无预兆地出现在富裕的玛莎葡萄园岛时，

sentences.en: it was the culmination of a months-long strategy by two of the country's most conservative governors to make undocumented immigration a problem for blue states, not just red ones.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是该国两位最保守的州长数月来策略的高潮，他们的目的是让无证移民成为蓝州的问题，而不仅仅是红州的问题。

sentences.en: My colleague, Miriam Jordan, on how that strategy has played out and what it's meant for the migrants caught in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我的同事米里亚姆·乔丹将为您讲述这一策略是如何运作的，以及它对深陷其中的移民意味着什么。

sentences.en: Wednesday, September 21St.
sentences.zh: 9月21日，星期三。

sentences.en: Miriam, how did all of this begin?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，这一切是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: Well, with the number of migrants arriving at the border growing very quickly, we have a very ambitious governor, Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 嗯，随着到达边境的移民人数增长非常迅速，我们有一位雄心勃勃的州长格雷格·阿博特。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, everybody, for being with us here today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢大家今天来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm joined today.
sentences.zh: 我今天加入了。

sentences.en: Who announced in early April that he had to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 他在4月初宣布，他必须对此采取行动。

sentences.en: Texas will be taking its own unprecedented actions this month.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州本月将采取空前的行动。

sentences.en: And he wanted to show the country and the White House that this shouldn't just be his problem.
sentences.zh: 他想向全国和白宫表明，这不应该仅仅是他的问题。

sentences.en: To help local officials whose communities are being overwhelmed by hordes of illegal immigrants who are being dropped off by the Biden administration,
sentences.zh: 为了帮助那些社区被拜登政府抛下的非法移民大军淹没的当地官员，

sentences.en: Texas is providing charter buses to send these illegal immigrants who have been dropped off by the Biden administration to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州正在提供包车，将这些被拜登政府抛下的非法移民送到华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: So he announced that he was going to start putting migrants on buses and shipping them to the nation's capital.
sentences.zh: 所以他宣布他要开始把移民送上巴士，并将他们运往国家首都。

sentences.en: Is there a place in D.C.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区有没有一个地方

sentences.en: that you all are planning to send these migrants to?
sentences.zh: 你们打算把这些移民送到那里？

sentences.en: Is there a designated area you guys have in this plan?
sentences.zh: 你们在这个计划中有一个指定区域吗？

sentences.en: The first location will be the steps of the United States Capitol.
sentences.zh: 第一个地点将是美国国会大厦的台阶。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And for an ambitious Republican governor who wants to make the point that immigration should not just be his problem or Texas' problem,
sentences.zh: 对于一个雄心勃勃的共和党州长来说，他想指出移民不应该仅仅是他或德克萨斯州的问题，

sentences.en: what could be more symbolically powerful than literally delivering migrants from his state to the president's doorstep in Washington, D.C.?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比字面意义上把来自他自己州的移民送到华盛顿特区总统门前更具象征意义的呢？

sentences.en: But, Miriam, what's happening in April in particular that motivates Abbott to do this?
sentences.zh: 但是，米里亚姆，4月份到底发生了什么促使阿博特这样做？

sentences.en: At this point in time, the governor is worried that a pandemic-era policy known as Title 42,
sentences.zh: 在这个时候，州长担心一项被称为“第42条”的大流行时期政策，

sentences.en: which was resulting in the expulsion swiftly of tens of thousands of migrants who showed up at the border back to Mexico—
sentences.zh: 该政策导致成千上万出现在边境的移民被迅速驱逐回墨西哥——

sentences.en: Expedited deportation, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是加速遣返。

sentences.en: Absolutely, yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 绝对的，是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Was going to be terminated by the Biden administration at the direction of the Centers for Disease Control.
sentences.zh: 将在疾病控制与预防中心的指导下被拜登政府终止。

sentences.en: That was due to occur in May.
sentences.zh: 这原定于5月发生。

sentences.en: And he said that this would result in millions of migrants showing up at the border, you know, as many migrants as live in some cities in Texas.
sentences.zh: 他说，这将导致数百万移民出现在边境，你知道的，和德克萨斯州一些城市的人口一样多。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And did that happen?
sentences.zh: 那发生了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: We didn't have millions of migrants arrive virtually overnight because the Biden administration did not terminate Title 42
sentences.zh: 我们并没有在一夜之间涌现数百万移民，因为拜登政府没有终止“第42条”，

sentences.en: because Texas and other Republican states sued to keep it in place.
sentences.zh: 因为德克萨斯州和其他共和党州起诉要求保留它。

sentences.en: So many of the migrants who are crossing the border are still getting quickly deported,
sentences.zh: 因此，许多过境的移民仍然被迅速驱逐，

sentences.en: but there are still lots of people coming, and many of these people can't be swiftly deported.
sentences.zh: 但仍有很多人到来，其中许多人无法被迅速驱逐。

sentences.en: One group of migrants in particular falls into that category, Venezuelans, because the United States does not have diplomatic relations with Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 有一群移民特别符合这一类，即委内瑞拉人，因为美国与委内瑞拉没有外交关系。

sentences.en: Therefore, they cannot be sent back.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们无法被遣返。

sentences.en: And let's just take a step back and talk a little bit about how broken Venezuela is.
sentences.zh: 让我们退一步，谈谈委内瑞拉目前的破碎状态。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请吧。

sentences.en: So this is now the country that has the second largest displaced population in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这个国家拥有世界上第二大流离失所人口。

sentences.en: Since about 2015, more than one out of five Venezuelans have left their home country to try to make a living in mainly neighboring countries like Colombia, Ecuador, Brazil.
sentences.zh: 大约从2015年起，五分之一以上的委内瑞拉人离开了他们的祖国，试图主要在哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、巴西等邻国谋生。

sentences.en: But with the advent of COVID and the hard hit that the economies of these countries took, they began to seek the United States as a better alternative.
sentences.zh: 但随着新冠肺炎的到来以及这些国家经济受到的沉重打击，他们开始将美国视为更好的选择。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because the economy here is, on a relative basis, thriving.
sentences.zh: 因为这里的经济在相对基础上正在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And so even with Title 42 still in place, we have this surge of migrants from Venezuela, and they're the fastest growing group showing up at the border.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在“第42条”仍然有效的情况下，我们仍然迎来了来自委内瑞拉的移民激增，他们是出现在边境增长最快的群体。

sentences.en: So Governor Abbott, who has a penchant for political drama, persists with his plan to bus these migrants from Texas to Washington.
sentences.zh: 因此，有政治戏剧倾向的阿博特州长坚持他的计划，将这些移民从德克萨斯州用巴士送到华盛顿。

sentences.en: So Miriam, how does Abbott just logistically get these migrants on a bus to Washington?
sentences.zh: 那么，米里亚姆，阿博特如何在后勤上让这些移民坐上开往华盛顿的巴士？

sentences.en: How does that work?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Well, typically migrants who are seeking asylum, like these Venezuelans, turn themselves into the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 通常寻求庇护的移民，比如这些委内瑞拉人，会向边境巡逻队自首。

sentences.en: The Border Patrol then takes them to a processing facility where it makes sure that they don't have a criminal record and releases them to a shelter in the area.
sentences.zh: 然后边境巡逻队把他们带到处理设施，在那里确保他们没有犯罪记录，并把他们释放到当地的一个庇护所。

sentences.en: And from the shelters, migrants usually find their way to their destination.
sentences.zh: 从庇护所出来后，移民通常会找到他们要去的地方。

sentences.en: But what was happening in this case was that officials from the state of Texas were approaching the migrants
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下发生的事情是，德克萨斯州官员正在接近这些移民

sentences.en: after they were released and offering them free bus rides to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 在他们被释放后，并向他们提供前往华盛顿特区的免费巴士票。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Texas is basically saying before you all scatter off to whatever place in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以德克萨斯州基本上是在说，在你们四处散落到美国任何地方之前

sentences.en: you think is best, let us take that problem off of your shoulders.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为最好，让我们把这个麻烦从你的肩膀上拿下来。

sentences.en: Here's a ride to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这是去华盛顿特区的车票。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没毛病。

sentences.en: And Venezuelans tend not to have friends or family in the United States to join.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉人在美国往往没有朋友或亲戚可以投靠。

sentences.en: So they may not even have a specific city in mind where they want to make a start or settle.
sentences.zh: 所以他们甚至可能没有一个具体的城市想要开始生活或定居。

sentences.en: That's very different from migrants from Mexico and from Guatemala, Honduras, other places in Central America who have family and relatives waiting for them here.
sentences.zh: 这与来自墨西哥、危地马拉、洪都拉斯和中美洲其他地方的移民非常不同，他们在这里有家人和亲戚在等他们。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Governor Abbott's strategy just happens to coincide with the emergence of Venezuelans
sentences.zh: 所以阿博特州长的策略恰逢委内瑞拉人的出现

sentences.en: as a major population crossing the border with no particular destination, as you said, in mind.
sentences.zh: 作为一个跨越边境的主要群体，正如你所说，没有特定的目的地。

sentences.en: And this invitation to go to Washington is pretty appealing, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来，这个去华盛顿的邀请相当吸引人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: And there are plenty of jobs in the service sector, in construction, transportation, hospitality, you name it, that are, you know, begging for workers.
sentences.zh: 服务业、建筑业、交通运输业、酒店业等有大量的工作岗位，可以说是求贤若渴。

sentences.en: And these migrants are willing to do pretty much any job to start sending money home to their families.
sentences.zh: 这些移民愿意做任何工作，开始把钱寄回给他们的家人。

sentences.en: And I hear that again and again.
sentences.zh: 我一次又一次地听到这种说法。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: For example, one of the migrants I met who'd crossed the border is named Lever Alejos.
sentences.zh: 例如，我遇到的一个过境移民名叫莱弗·阿莱霍斯。

sentences.en: Lever, who's 29, had been solidly middle class in a northern Venezuelan town.
sentences.zh: 现年29岁的莱弗在委内瑞拉北部的一个小镇上曾是不折不扣的中产阶级。

sentences.en: He had been running his own machine repair shop for many years and felt steady and stable.
sentences.zh: 他经营自己的机器修理铺多年，感觉很踏实也很稳定。

sentences.en: But with his country falling apart, he suddenly could not provide for his son.
sentences.zh: 但随着国家的崩溃，他突然无法养活他的儿子了。

sentences.en: His business couldn't stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 他的生意无法维持下去了。

sentences.en: And he made the decision to sell the shop.
sentences.zh: 他做出了卖掉店铺的决定。

sentences.en: And with the $750 that he made on it, embark on this journey over land to reach the southern border.
sentences.zh: 带着卖店得来的750美元，踏上了陆路前往南部边境的旅程。

sentences.en: Once he finally arrives at the border, he's processed by immigration authorities and released.
sentences.zh: 一旦他最终到达边境，他就会被移民当局处理并释放。

sentences.en: After he's released, he's in a shed outside his shelter with a bunch of other migrants.
sentences.zh: 在他被释放后，他和一大群移民呆在庇护所外的一个棚子里。

sentences.en: And they're approached about this possibility of a free ride to Washington.
sentences.zh: 有人向他们接洽免费去华盛顿的可能。

sentences.en: And the way he explained it to me was that the migrants were told that if they had no money, they would be better off getting on a bus that was free
sentences.zh: 他对我的解释是，移民被告知如果他们没有钱，最好坐一辆免费的巴士

sentences.en: than trying to figure out how they were going to leave the border.
sentences.zh: 而不是去想如何离开边境。

sentences.en: And at this point, Lever told me that he had no money left and didn't really know how he was going to get to the interior of the country.
sentences.zh: 此时，莱弗告诉我他身无分文，也不知道自己将如何进入内陆。

sentences.en: But he was desperate to get to a city where he could find work and start sending money home.
sentences.zh: 但他非常渴望去一个能找到工作并开始寄钱回家的城市。

sentences.en: And this bus ride was this gift.
sentences.zh: 而这趟巴士之旅就是这份礼物。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 所以他接受了。

sentences.en: He takes it gladly.
sentences.zh: 他欣然接受。

sentences.zh: 那么，米里亚姆，这些委内瑞拉移民，像莱弗这样的人，一旦他们的巴士到达华盛顿，会发生什么？

sentences.zh: 所以，也许是有意为之，德克萨斯州州长没有提前通知任何人

sentences.zh: 果不其然，当地刚过早上8点，一辆巴士出现，23名移民下车，

sentences.zh: 19名男性，4名女性，还有两个幼儿。

sentences.en: D.C.

sentences.zh: 移民援助组织称，每天大约有100人到达。

sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: By early August, Abbott delivered more than 6,200 migrants from the southern border to the nation's capital.
sentences.zh: 到8月初，阿博特已将6200多名来自南部边境的移民送到国家首都。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He was sending a message to his base that he was doing the best he could to control the border while Democrats in Washington were failing.
sentences.zh: 他是在向他的基本盘传达这样一个信息：他在尽最大努力控制边境，而华盛顿的民主党人却在失败。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But Abbott didn't stop there.
sentences.zh: 但阿博特并没有就此罢休。

sentences.en: He started sending buses to New York City, too.
sentences.zh: 他也开始向纽约市发送巴士。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So now Governor Abbott is taking aim at another big Democratic city.
sentences.zh: 所以现在阿博特州长把目标对准了另一个民主党大城市。

sentences.en: First, it's Washington, D.C., where he's sending these migrants from the border.
sentences.zh: 首先是华盛顿特区，他把这些来自边境的移民送到那里。

sentences.en: Now he's sending them to New York City, clearly trying to make the same point in an even bigger metropolis.
sentences.zh: 现在他把他们送到纽约市，显然是在一个更大的大都市里试图表达同样的观点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And then we have this back and forth between the Republican governor and these Democratic mayors who are really angry at what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到共和党州长和这些对他的所作所为感到非常生气的民主党市长之间来回拉扯。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he fires back that, well, you love immigrants.
sentences.zh: 而对方反驳说，哦，你们喜欢移民。

sentences.en: You're sanctuary cities.
sentences.zh: 你们是庇护城市。

sentences.en: And he's correct, right?
sentences.zh: 他说得对，对吧？

sentences.en: Washington, D.C., New York City have designated themselves as places that will not help deport undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区和纽约市将自己指定为不会协助遣返无证移民的地区。

sentences.en: That's what it means to be a sanctuary city.
sentences.zh: 这就是“庇护城市”的意思。

sentences.en: Is that correct?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That these cities will not participate in any official effort to rid themselves of immigrants who arrive, regardless of whether they enter the country with authorization or not.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这些城市不会参与任何官方行动去驱逐抵达的移民，无论他们是否获得授权入境。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what Abbott is saying is, if you're sanctuaries, be a sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 所以阿博特的意思是，既然你们是庇护城市，那就拿出点庇护的样子。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So throughout August, this pattern continues of bus after bus arriving in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以在整个八月份，一辆又一辆巴士抵达华盛顿特区和纽约的这种模式一直在持续。

sentences.en: and in New York.
sentences.zh: 还有纽约。

sentences.en: Chicago becomes the next city.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥成了下一个城市。

sentences.en: And suddenly we see the governor of Florida pushing this tactic further.
sentences.zh: 随即我们看到佛罗里达州长将这一策略进一步推向深入。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: And why so?
sentences.zh: 又为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Well, Florida, yeah, it's not a border state, but Governor DeSantis is also a very ambitious politician.
sentences.zh: 嗯，佛罗里达州，是的，它不是一个边境州，但德桑蒂斯州长也是一位极具野心的政客。

sentences.en: He, as we know, has his eye on the White House.
sentences.zh: 如我们所知，他正盯着白宫呢。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Basically, he's a Republican rival to Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他是格雷格·阿博特的共和党竞争对手。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And he sees the traction that Abbott is getting with this issue.
sentences.zh: 他看到了阿博特在这一议题上获得的关注度。

sentences.en: So maybe it's time for him to do something bigger and better.
sentences.zh: 所以也许是时候由他来做点更大更好的事了。

sentences.en: And what might that be?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么呢？

sentences.en: Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 马莎葡萄园岛。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以收看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Miriam, can you just explain what Martha's Vineyard is, what it represents, and why Governor DeSantis of Florida, in his effort to, in a way, one-up
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，你能否解释一下什么是马莎葡萄园岛，它代表着什么，以及为什么佛罗里达州长德桑蒂斯为了在某种程度上压

sentences.en: Governor Abbott of Texas decides that this is the place where he is going to send migrants.
sentences.zh: 得德克萨斯州长阿博特一头，而决定将移民送到这个地方？

sentences.en: Well, Martha's Vineyard is this idyllic, seasonal vacation spot for ultra-wealthy folks in Massachusetts off the coast of Cape Cod.
sentences.zh: 嗯，马莎葡萄园岛是马萨诸塞州科德角海岸外，专供超级富豪们度假的田园诗般的季节性度假胜地。

sentences.en: It's famous for being beloved by Democrats, the Kennedys spent time there, the Clintons, the Obamas have a house there, Hollywood royalties spend summers there.
sentences.zh: 它因备受民主党人喜爱而闻名，肯尼迪家族曾在那儿度假，克林顿夫妇、奥巴马在那里有房产，好莱坞巨星们也会去那里度夏。

sentences.en: It's the ultimate liberal bastion.
sentences.zh: 它是终极的自由派大本营。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But at its core, it's just basically a beach town.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，它基本上就是一个海滩小镇。

sentences.en: It's a speck of an island.
sentences.zh: 它只是一个小岛。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And there's not much going on there except during high season over the summer.
sentences.zh: 除了夏天的高峰期，那里平时并没有太多事情发生。

sentences.en: So given all that, how does the governor of Florida persuade migrants to go to this, as you, Miriam, called it, speck of an island, this vacation spot,
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，佛罗里达州长是如何说服移民前往这个你（米里亚姆）所说的弹丸之地、这个度假胜地的呢？

sentences.en: where economic opportunity wouldn't seem to be all that plentiful?
sentences.zh: 那里的经济机会似乎并不怎么丰富。

sentences.en: With a lot of pre-planning.
sentences.zh: 通过大量的精心策划。

sentences.en: From our reporting, we gathered that an envoy who identified herself as Perla was dispatched to San Antonio, where a group of migrants were standing in a parking lot across
sentences.zh: 根据我们的报道，我们了解到一名自称佩尔拉的特使被派往圣安东尼奥，当时一群移民正站在庇护所对面的

sentences.en: from a shelter and started distributing McDonald's gift cards to them.
sentences.zh: 停车场里，她开始向他们分发麦当劳礼品卡。

sentences.en: And then she made them an offer that many of them couldn't refuse, a free flight to Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 然后她向他们提出了一个许多人无法拒绝的提议：一张去马萨诸塞州的免费机票。

sentences.en: So just to make sure I understand this, because it's a little bit complicated, the governor of Florida is dispatching someone to Texas, several states away,
sentences.zh: 为了确保我没理解错，因为这有点复杂，佛罗里达州长派人去了几个州之外的德克萨斯州，

sentences.en: to essentially use immigrants there to accomplish his goal of sending migrants to Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 本质上是为了利用那里的移民来达成他将移民送往马萨诸塞州的目标。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's weird, but I guess he couldn't find migrants in his own state, so he had to go to the point of entry for the migrants.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很怪，但我想他在自己的州找不到移民，所以不得不去移民的入境点。

sentences.en: And in fact, it seems that this woman who identified herself as Perla to the migrants was so intent on filling planes to Martha's Vineyard
sentences.zh: 事实上，这位向移民自称佩尔拉的女性似乎铁了心要填满去马莎葡萄园岛的航班，

sentences.en: that she not only was interacting and enticing migrants at the McDonald's, but I spoke with migrants who encountered her when they were in a supermarket nearby
sentences.zh: 她不仅在麦当劳与移民互动并诱导他们，我还和一些移民交谈过，他们在附近的超市

sentences.en: or walking down the street looking for work.
sentences.zh: 或在街上找工作时遇到了她。

sentences.en: And in fact, told her, if you want to help me, I want work.
sentences.zh: 甚至还对她说，如果你想帮我，我想找工作。

sentences.en: Not a flight necessarily to Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 不一定非要去马萨诸塞州坐飞机。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And she presented them with this opportunity to go to Massachusetts and assure them that they would get on a path to finding jobs and laying down roots once they arrived.
sentences.zh: 她向他们提供了去马萨诸塞州的机会，并向他们保证，一旦抵达，他们就能走上寻找工作和扎根的道路。

sentences.en: And as we now all know, some number of them say yes.
sentences.zh: 正如我们现在所知，其中一部分人答应了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So eventually, Perla has gathered about 50 people who she puts on two planes to Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 最终，佩尔拉聚集了大约50人，把他们塞进两架飞往马莎葡萄园岛的飞机。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And do these migrants know they're going to Martha's Vineyard?
sentences.zh: 这些移民知道自己要去马莎葡萄园岛吗？

sentences.en: The migrants we've interviewed have told us that they did not understand that they were going to end up on a small island.
sentences.zh: 我们采访过的移民告诉我们，他们并不知道自己最后会去一个小岛。

sentences.en: Many of them told us that they understood that they were going to Massachusetts and were assured that Boston was their destination.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人告诉我们，他们只知道自己要去马萨诸塞州，并被保证目的地是波士顿。

sentences.en: So in a sense, they were deceived.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们被欺骗了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so what happens once these roughly 50 migrants land on the island of Martha's Vineyard?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这大约50名移民登陆马莎葡萄园岛后，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, just as in the case of D.C.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像华盛顿特区

sentences.en: and New York, no advance warning was given.
sentences.zh: 和纽约的情况一样，事先没有任何警告。

sentences.en: So when they deplane, they're basically wandering around, wondering where they are, what's happened.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们下飞机时，基本上是在四处游荡，纳闷自己身在何方，发生了什么。

sentences.en: But I have to imagine, unlike New York or D.C., which have a lot of built-in resources that they can provide to migrants who show up,
sentences.zh: 但我可以想象，与纽约或华盛顿特区不同，那里有大量现成资源可以提供给出现的移民，

sentences.en: that Martha's Vineyard, this tiny island off the coast of Massachusetts, does not.
sentences.zh: 而马莎葡萄园岛这个马萨诸塞州海岸外的小岛则没有。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说得对。

sentences.en: And by the way, while there's plenty of work in Martha's Vineyard during the high season, the season has just ended.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，虽然在旺季时马莎葡萄园岛有大量工作，但旺季刚刚结束。

sentences.en: So there's not work, which is precisely what these people want, on the vineyard right now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在岛上并没有这些移民梦寐以求的工作。

sentences.en: So the idea of sending migrants to D.C.
sentences.zh: 因此，把移民送到华盛顿特区

sentences.en: and New York was a stunt, but it was a stunt with some theoretical rationale, whereas Martha's Vineyard is a stunt without any real rationale,
sentences.zh: 和纽约的想法是一场噱头，但这是一场带有某种理论合理性的噱头，而马莎葡萄园岛则是一场毫无实际合理性的噱头，

sentences.en: other than kind of sticking it to, as you said, a liberal bastion for the elite,
sentences.zh: 除了正如你所说，有点像是去给精英们的自由派大本营难堪，

sentences.en: because there is not the infrastructure or really the jobs at the end of the summer for migrants there.
sentences.zh: 因为夏天一过，那里既没有基础设施，也没有真正的工作岗位来安置移民。

sentences.en: You know, that's right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，确实如此。

sentences.en: But the community rallied around these immigrants.
sentences.zh: 但当地社区团结起来支援了这些移民。

sentences.en: This parish house bustling with activity.
sentences.zh: 这个教区大楼里一派繁忙景象。

sentences.en: Volunteers and organizers working since yesterday to provide food, shelter, and immigration services.
sentences.zh: 志愿者和组织者从昨天开始就一直在工作，提供食物、住所和移民服务。

sentences.en: Local churches, synagogue, mobilized volunteers who delivered food and clothing, toys.
sentences.zh: 当地的教堂和犹太教堂动员了志愿者，送来食物、衣物和玩具。

sentences.en: Even giving many of the migrants phones, some of them getting the chance to speak with loved ones for the first time in months
sentences.zh: 甚至给许多移民发了手机，其中一些人得以在几个月内首次与亲人通话，

sentences.en: after they've traversed even seven countries to get to America.
sentences.zh: 此前他们甚至穿越了七个国家才来到美国。

sentences.en: And spent time with the migrants, helping them to feel comfortable, safe, welcome.
sentences.zh: 并花时间陪伴移民，帮助他们感到舒适、安全和受欢迎。

sentences.en: What makes America great is what we see here today, which is an island community and a state in Massachusetts that's coming together to support the people here.
sentences.zh: 今天在这里看到的情景正是美国伟大的体现：一个岛屿社区和马萨诸塞州齐心协力支持这里的人民。

sentences.en: And migrants who I interviewed were saying that they were feeling cared for.
sentences.zh: 我采访的移民说，他们感受到了关爱。

sentences.en: And one of them couldn't speak any English, but to say, I love Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 其中一人不会说英语，却直言：“我爱马萨诸塞。”

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So despite these migrants being misled about exactly where they were going, many of them ended up somewhat pleasantly surprised by being in Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管这些移民被误导了目的地，但许多人最终来到马莎葡萄园岛后，反而感到有点惊喜。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what is the reaction to this stunt from the governor of Florida?
sentences.zh: 那么佛罗里达州长对这场噱头有什么反应呢？

sentences.en: Well, DeSantis basically reignited the whole firestorm that was started by Abbott.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德桑蒂斯基本上重新点燃了由阿博特掀起的舆论风暴。

sentences.en: By relocating dozens of migrants, he seemed to create the same kind of stir Abbott had caused by relocating thousands.
sentences.zh: 通过重新安置几十名移民，他似乎制造了与阿博特安置数千人时同等规模的轰动。

sentences.en: It's really shameful.
sentences.zh: 这真的很无耻。

sentences.en: It's twisted.
sentences.zh: 这简直扭曲。

sentences.en: It is pathetic that these governors are taking advantage of these helpless people.
sentences.zh: 这些州长利用这些无助的人，真是太可悲了。

sentences.en: On the left, there's a huge amount of outrage.
sentences.zh: 在左翼，引发了巨大的愤怒。

sentences.en: Instead of working with us on solutions,
sentences.zh: 共和党人不仅不与我们合作寻找解决方案，

sentences.en: Republicans are playing politics with human beings.
sentences.zh: 反而在拿人类的生命当政治筹码。

sentences.en: You have some criticizing the governor for playing games with migrants' lives.
sentences.zh: 有些人批评州长拿移民的生命当游戏。

sentences.en: He effectively kidnapped these people, luring them onto planes with promises of jobs.
sentences.zh: 他实际上绑架了这些人，用工作承诺诱骗他们登上飞机。

sentences.en: And then he proceeded to send them to a tiny island with no support services.
sentences.zh: 然后又将他们送到了一个没有任何支援服务的小岛上。

sentences.en: Because here, there's not even the plausible deniability that he was trying to connect them to resources.
sentences.zh: 因为在这里，他甚至无法借口说自己是在试图将他们与资源对接，连这种表面上的推脱都不存在了。

sentences.en: I absolutely think the DOJ should investigate here.
sentences.zh: 我绝对认为美国司法部应该在此展开调查。

sentences.en: Some people are even calling for an investigation into whether this amounted to human trafficking.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至呼吁调查这是否构成了贩运人口。

sentences.en: They're sending people across state lines under false pretenses.
sentences.zh: 他们以虚假的借口将人们跨州运送。

sentences.en: They are essentially trafficking these people for their own political gain.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是为了自己的政治利益而在贩运这些人。

sentences.en: But the conservative media celebrates the fact that liberal America is having to confront this immigration problem at its doorstep.
sentences.zh: 但保守派媒体却在庆祝，因为自由派美国不得不直面家门口的这场移民问题。

sentences.en: They're outraged by the idea of illegal aliens near their island vacation homes.
sentences.zh: 他们对岛上度假屋附近出现非法移民感到愤怒。

sentences.en: But for long, they'll be tweeting in solidarity with the Vineyard's white community.
sentences.zh: 但过不了多久，他们就会发推特声援葡萄园岛的白人社区。

sentences.en: Hashtag, I stand with Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 话题标签：我与马莎葡萄园岛站在一起。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson, the Fox News anchor, devoted an entire monologue on his show to the fact that liberals on this island had finally been forced to confront
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻主播塔克·卡尔森在节目中用了一整段独白，大谈特谈这个岛上的自由派终于被迫去面对

sentences.en: a problem that they lived far removed from.
sentences.zh: 一个他们长期置身事外的问题。

sentences.en: They are so insulated from the effects of Joe Biden's lunatic immigration policies that none of it matters to them.
sentences.zh: 他们与乔·拜登疯狂的移民政策带来的影响隔绝得如此彻底，以至于这一切对他们来说都无关紧要。

sentences.en: And DeSantis seems to be relishing this moment in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 而德桑蒂斯似乎很享受这种处于聚光灯下的时刻。

sentences.en: We take what's happening at the southern border very seriously, unlike some, and unlike the president of the United States, who has refused to lift a finger to secure that border.
sentences.zh: 我们非常严肃地对待南部边境发生的事情，不像某些人，也不像美国总统，他拒绝动一根手指来保卫该边境。

sentences.en: He held a press conference last week where he doubled down on his decision to send people up north and, in fact, did not back off from the idea of doing it again.
sentences.zh: 他上周举行了一场新闻发布会，在会上他坚定了将人们送往北方的决定，事实上，他并没有放弃再次这样做的想法。

sentences.en: Our message to them is we are not a sanctuary state, and it's better to be able to go to a sanctuary jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 我们对他们传达的信息是，我们不是一个庇护州，去往庇护辖区会更好。

sentences.en: And yes, we will help facilitate that transport for you to be able to go to greener pastures.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们将协助你们进行这种交通转运，让你们能够前往更好的地方。

sentences.en: So how should we be thinking about the larger meaning of all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何看待这一切更深层的意义呢？

sentences.en: Not just what happened on Martha's Vineyard, but in D.C.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是马莎葡萄园岛上发生的事，还有过去几个月在华盛顿特区

sentences.en: and in New York over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 和纽约发生的事。

sentences.en: These Republican governors start off by saying, we want the burden of undocumented immigration to be shared by many states, not just those who live on the border.
sentences.zh: 这些共和党州长一开始就说，我们希望无证移民的负担由多个州共同分担，而不仅仅是边境居民。

sentences.en: And they're accomplishing that, but in arguably a pretty deceptive, many would say cruel way.
sentences.zh: 他们确实做到了这一点，但可以说是以一种相当欺骗性的、许多人会说是残忍的方式。

sentences.en: Because arguably, if these governors wanted to do so, they could work with blue states, right?
sentences.zh: 因为可以说，如果这些州长愿意的话，他们完全可以与蓝州合作，对吧？

sentences.en: Governor Abbott could work with New York, could work with Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 阿博特州长可以与纽约合作，可以与华盛顿特区合作。

sentences.en: Governor DeSantis could work with Massachusetts to facilitate an orderly transfer of migrants to these jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯州长可以与马萨诸塞州合作，以促进移民有序转移到这些辖区。

sentences.en: But these governors haven't done it that way.
sentences.zh: 但这些州长并没有这么做。

sentences.en: They're not doing it in good faith.
sentences.zh: 他们不是出于善意在做事。

sentences.en: They're doing it in a way that's meant deliberately, it seems, to be chaotic.
sentences.zh: 他们的做法似乎是故意要制造混乱。

sentences.en: So what should we make of that?
sentences.zh: 那我们该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: That it's not in their political interest to find a solution to the problem.
sentences.zh: 说明寻找问题的解决方案并不符合他们的政治利益。

sentences.en: It seems to be a priority to elevate the problem in the public square to benefit them in their political careers rather than to try to sit down
sentences.zh: 他们的首要任务似乎是在公众面前炒作这个问题，以在他们的政治生涯中谋利，而不是坐下来

sentences.en: and have a meaningful dialogue with the Democratic leadership on how to address this problem.
sentences.zh: 与民主党领导层进行有意义的对话，探讨如何解决这个问题。

sentences.en: There's no doubt that there are very large numbers of people showing up at our border.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，有大量的人涌向我们的边境。

sentences.en: The world is in turmoil.
sentences.zh: 世界正处于动荡之中。

sentences.en: I've never seen as many people from as many countries before at the border.
sentences.zh: 我从未在边境见过这么多来自这么多国家的民众。

sentences.en: And they're not going to stop coming as long as they're desperate and in search of a better life.
sentences.zh: 只要他们陷入绝望并寻求更好的生活，他们就不会停止到来。

sentences.en: So it's really ultimately incumbent on Congress to fix our broken immigration system.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终修复我们破碎的移民系统确实是国会的责任。

sentences.en: But we've never seemed farther away from coming to a consensus on how to do that because the country is so divided, the parties are so polarized,
sentences.zh: 但由于国家如此分裂，各党派极度两极分化，我们似乎从未像现在这样距离达成如何解决这一问题的共识如此遥远

sentences.en: and there seems to be no will to come to the table.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎没有人愿意坐下来谈判。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And these governors are not encouraging anyone to come to the table with these tactics.
sentences.zh: 这些州长采取这种战术，并没有鼓励任何人来谈判。

sentences.en: No, they are not.
sentences.zh: 是的，并没有。

sentences.en: Miriam, you had told us at the beginning of our conversation about the story of Lever Alejos, the Venezuelan man who took that bus ride to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，我们在对话一开始时，你向我们讲述了莱弗·阿莱霍斯的故事，那个坐大巴去华盛顿特区的委内瑞拉男子。

sentences.en: And I'm curious how he's doing.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇他现在过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Is he still in Washington?
sentences.zh: 他还在华盛顿吗？

sentences.en: Lever is still in Washington, and he's thriving, considering where he was at when I first met him.
sentences.zh: 莱弗还在华盛顿，而且考虑到我刚见到他时的状况，他现在过得很不错。

sentences.en: Lever has found a job working at concession stands, soccer games, football games.
sentences.zh: 莱弗找到了一份在小吃摊、足球赛和橄榄球赛工作的工作。

sentences.en: He's sending money home to his seven-year-old son.
sentences.zh: 他正在把钱寄回给他在老家的七岁儿子。

sentences.en: He's bought himself a new cell phone.
sentences.zh: 他给自己买了一部新手机。

sentences.en: He's making plans to buy a car, a used car, a 2012 Honda Civic, but nonetheless a car so that he doesn't have to rely on public transportation.
sentences.zh: 他正计划买辆车，一辆二手车，一辆2012款本田思域，但无论如何是一辆车，这样他就不用依赖公共交通了。

sentences.en: And after that, he plans to move out of the shelter where he has been living since I met him in late July.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他计划搬出那个庇护所，自从七月下旬我遇到他以来，他一直住在那里。

sentences.en: Find a place to live, either share an apartment with some other Venezuelans or rent a room somewhere.
sentences.zh: 找个地方住，要么和其他委内瑞拉人合租一套公寓，要么在某个地方租个房间。

sentences.en: And he actually told me that he's grateful that he got on the Abbott bus to Washington.
sentences.zh: 他实际上告诉我，他很感激自己坐上了阿博特去华盛顿的大巴。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: He's grateful to Governor Abbott.
sentences.zh: 他很感激阿博特州长。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: While fully understanding that Governor Abbott put him on that bus because the governor did not want him and other migrants to stay in his state.
sentences.zh: 虽然他完全清楚阿博特州长把他送上那辆大巴是因为州长不想让他和、其他移民留在他的州。

sentences.en: He feels that that opened up a world of possibilities for him because it brought him to a city where he has found that there's a lot of opportunity for growth and he feels like he's in a good place.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得这为他打开了一个充满可能性的世界，因为它把他带到了一个城市，在那里他发现有很多发展的机会，他觉得自己的处境很好。

sentences.en: Miriam, there's kind of an irony to his story, right?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，他的故事有点讽刺意味，对吧？

sentences.en: And I don't know exactly how representative it is, but just to focus on him for a minute, he's thriving.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这有多大代表性，但仅仅关注他一会儿，他现在过得很好。

sentences.en: And when I think back to what Governor Abbott wanted to accomplish by sending migrants like him from Texas to Washington, it was to diminish and try to end these border crossings.
sentences.zh: 当我回想阿博特州长想通过把像他这样的移民从得克萨斯州送到华盛顿来达到什么目的时，那是为了减少并试图结束这些越境行为。

sentences.en: But his success, the fact that he's doing so well now in Washington, would seem to perhaps encourage this kind of migration, right?
sentences.zh: 但他的成功，他在华盛顿现在过得这么好的事实，似乎可能会鼓励这种移民潮，对吧？

sentences.en: And I don't suspect that's what Governor Abbott intended.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是阿博特州长的本意。

sentences.en: No, I don't think that was his intention.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为这不是他的本意。

sentences.en: People like Lever are telling their friends as we speak that they found work, that they're doing well, and so others will follow.
sentences.zh: 像莱弗这样的人正在亲口告诉他们的朋友，他们找到了工作，他们过得很好，所以其他人会效仿。

sentences.en: And in fact, as has been the case for decades, more people will hear this story and come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几十年来一直如此，更多的人会听到这个故事并来到美国，

sentences.en: because our system is broken and it allows that to happen.
sentences.zh: 因为我们的体制已经崩溃，它允许这种情况发生。

sentences.en: The reality is this is an intractable problem and moving people around the country on buses and in planes from state to state isn't going to solve the immigration problem.
sentences.zh: 现实是，这是一个棘手的问题，用大巴和飞机把人们在全国范围内从一个州送到另一个州并不能解决移民问题。

sentences.en: Miriam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: After we spoke with Miriam, a sheriff in Texas announced he had opened a criminal investigation into the flight that took migrants from San Antonio to Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在我们与米里亚姆交谈后，得克萨斯州的一名警长宣布，他已对将移民从圣安东尼奥送到马莎葡萄园岛的航班展开刑事调查。

sentences.en: I believe there's some criminal activity involved here.
sentences.zh: 我相信这里面涉及一些犯罪活动。

sentences.en: During a news conference, the sheriff, Javier Salazar, said it appeared that the migrants had been lured to Martha's Vineyard under false pretenses.
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，警长哈维尔·萨拉查表示，这些移民似乎是在虚假借口下被诱骗到马莎葡萄园岛的。

sentences.en: Somebody coming and preying upon people that are here minding their own business and are here legally, not bothering a soul, but somebody saw fit to come from another state,
sentences.zh: 有人来盘剥那些在这里安分守己、合法居留、没有招惹任何人的人，但有人觉得有必要从另一个州过来，

sentences.en: hunt them down, pray upon them, and then take advantage of their desperate situation just for the sake of political theater,
sentences.zh: 追捕他们，盘剥他们，然后仅仅为了政治作秀而利用他们绝望的处境，

sentences.en: just for the sake of making some sort of a statement and putting people's lives in danger.
sentences.zh: 仅仅为了发表某种声明并把人们的生命置于危险之中。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A grand jury has indicted 44 people in Minnesota on charges that they defrauded federal programs designed to feed poor children during the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州的一个大陪审团起诉了44人，指控他们诈骗旨在疫情期间为贫困儿童提供饮食的联邦项目，

sentences.en: stealing $240 million by billing the government for meals they didn't serve to children that did not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 通过为他们根本没有为不存在的孩子提供的膳食向政府开具账单，盗取了2.4亿美元。

sentences.en: It appears to be the largest claim of fraud uncovered in any pandemic relief program.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是在任何疫情救济项目中发现的最大欺诈索赔。

sentences.en: And Russia says that four Ukrainian regions, occupied wholly or in part by its troops, would hold referendums on joining Russia in the coming days,
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯表示，其军队全部或部分占领的四个乌克兰地区将在未来几天举行加入俄罗斯的全民公投，

sentences.en: a move widely seen as a prelude to annexation of those territories by Russia.
sentences.zh: 此举被普遍视为俄罗斯吞并这些领土的前奏。

sentences.en: Such referendums, which are seen as sham elections, are significant because they would allow Russia to declare those regions as official Russian territory
sentences.zh: 这类被视为虚假选举的全民公投意义重大，因为它们将允许俄罗斯宣布这些地区为俄罗斯官方领土，

sentences.en: and any attacks on them to be attacks on Russian land.
sentences.zh: 并且对它们的任何袭击都将是对俄罗斯领土的袭击。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Sydney Harper, and Muj Zady, with help from Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、悉尼·哈珀和穆吉·扎迪制作，威尔·里德提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Rowan Nemisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由莉兹·奥巴伦剪辑，包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和罗温·内米斯托的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由吉姆·布伦伯格和旺德利的本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线cutter秀》上，我们正准备迎接节假日的接待工作。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人在家一样自在的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方找到《电线cutter秀》。
